description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds, milliseconds, microseconds or nanoseconds, auto-detected) to a readable date, or a date/time string (e.g. 2026-12-25 09:00, read in the given time zone unless it has its own offset) to a Unix timestamp. Also returns weekday, ISO week and how long ago or until.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for display and for dates without an offset (default UTC)

value.description: Timestamp like 1760000000 or a date like 2026-12-25T09:00

name: convert_timestamp
